JAPN 100.description: An introduction to modern spoken and written Japanese with emphasis on both form (grammar and syntax) and functions (Non-intensive). Not available for credit to students with JAPN 11 and/or JAPN 12. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 100 or JAPN_V 160. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 101.description: Continuation of JAPN_V 100 (Non-intensive). Not available for credit to students with JAPN 12. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 101 or JAPN_V 160. Recommended pre-requisite: JAPN_V 100. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 160.description: An introduction to modern spoken and written Japanese with emphasis on both form (grammar and syntax) and functions. Offered in Term 1. Not available for credit to students with JAPN 12. Students are recommended to complete JAPN_V 160 and 260 in the same year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 160 or JAPN_V 150 or both JAPN_V 100, JAPN_V 101. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 200.description: Continuation of JAPN_V 101 (Non-intensive). Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 200 or JAPN_V 102 or JAPN_V 260. Recommended pre-requisite: one of JAPN_V 101, JAPN_V 150, JAPN_V 160. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 201.description: Continuation of JAPN 200 (Non-intensive). Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 201 or JAPN_V 103 or JAPN_V 260. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 102, JAPN_V 200. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 204.description: Emphasis on grammar, writing and reading Intended for students with a background in spoken Japanese. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 204 or JAPN_V 104. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 260.description: Continuation of JAPN_V 160. Offered in Term 2. Students are recommended to complete JAPN_V 160 and 260 in the same year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 260 or JAPN_V 151 or both JAPN_V 102, JAPN_V 103 or both JAPN_V 200, JAPN_V 201. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 101, JAPN_V 150, JAPN_V 160. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 261.description: An integrated language course developing communicative competence in speaking, listening to, reading, and writing modern Japanese. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 261 or JAPN_V 161. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 320.description: Integrated coverage of topics on culture and cross-cultural communication designed to develop competencies in speaking, listening, reading, and writing. It is strongly recommended that JAPN_V 320 and JAPN_V 321 be taken in the same year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 320 or JAPN_V 210 or JAPN_V 360. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 103, JAPN_V 151, JAPN_V 201, JAPN_V 260. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 321.description: Continuation of JAPN_V 320. It is strongly recommended that JAPN_V 320 and JAPN_V 321 be taken in the same year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 321 or JAPN_V 211 or JAPN_V 360. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 210, JAPN_V 320. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 322.description: It is strongly recommended that students plan to complete both JAPN_V 322 and JAPN_V 323 within one year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 322 or JAPN_V 212 or JAPN_V 361. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 211, JAPN_V 250, JAPN_V 321, JAPN_V 360. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 323.description: A continuation of JAPN_V 322. It is strongly recommended that students plan to complete both JAPN_V 322 and JAPN_V 323 within one year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 323 and JAPN_V 212 or JAPN_V 361. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 212, JAPN_V 322. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 342.course_name: Reading Course in Japanese for Honours Students

JAPN 360.description: Integrated coverage of topics on culture and cross-cultural communication designed to develop competencies in speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Offered in Term 1. It is strongly recommended that students plan to complete both JAPN_V 360 and JAPN_V 361 within one year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 360 or JAPN_V 212 or both JAPN_V 210, JAPN_V 211 or both JAPN_V 320, JAPN_V 321. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 103, JAPN_V 151, JAPN_V 201, JAPN_V 260. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 361.description: Continuation of JAPN_V 360. It is strongly recommended that students plan to complete both JAPN_V 360 and JAPN_V 361 within one year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 361 or JAPN_V 251 or both JAPN_V 212, JAPN_V 213 or both JAPN_V 322, JAPN_V 323. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 211, JAPN_V 250, JAPN_V 321, JAPN_V 360. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 400.course_name: Advanced Modern Japanese: Reading and Writing I
JAPN 400.description: Selected texts covering various aspects of Japanese cultural history and contemporary Japanese culture/society; emphasis on grammatical analysis and development of advanced competencies for reading and writing. It is strongly recommended that students plan to complete both JAPN_V 400 and JAPN_V 401 within one year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 400 or JAPN_V 300. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 213, JAPN_V 251, JAPN_V 323, JAPN_V 361. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 401.course_name: Advanced Modern Japanese: Reading and Writing II
JAPN 401.description: Continuation of JAPN_V 301. It is strongly recommended that students plan to complete both JAPN_V 400 and JAPN_V 401 within one year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 401 or JAPN_V 301. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 300, JAPN_V 400. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 402.course_name: Advanced Modern Japanese: Conversation and Composition I
JAPN 402.description: Improvement of speaking and writing skills through readings and discussions on a variety of social and cultural issues; emphasis on appropriate language use in formal situations. It is strongly recommended that students plan to complete both JAPN_V 402 and JAPN_V 403 within one year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 402 or JAPN_V 302. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 213, JAPN_V 251, JAPN_V 323, JAPN_V 361. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 403.course_name: Advanced Modern Japanese: Conversation and Composition II
JAPN 403.description: Improvement of speaking and writing skills through readings and discussions on a variety of social and cultural issues; emphasis on the development of formal presentation skills. It is strongly recommended that students plan to complete both JAPN_V 402 and JAPN_V 403 within one year. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 403 or JAPN_V 303. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 302, JAPN_V 402. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 422.description: The grammar, orthography, and literary style of pre-modern Japanese (bungo). It is strongly recommended that students have 12 credits of JAPN, or equivalent, prior to registration. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 422 or JAPN 311.

JAPN 423.description: A continuation of JAPN 422. Focus on reading pre-modern primary sources and producing English translations. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 423 or JAPN 312. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN 311, JAPN 422.

JAPN 424.description: Technical Japanese as it is used in business, commerce, industry, etc. Emphasis on specialized current vocabulary and on the development of communicative competence relevant for workplaces in these fields. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 424 or JAPN 314. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN 213, JAPN 251, JAPN 323, JAPN 361.

JAPN 425.description: Continuation of JAPN 424. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 425 or JAPN 315. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN 314, JAPN 424.

JAPN 450.description: Oral communication skills appropriate for studying and working in a Japanese-speaking environment either formal or informal. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 450 or JAPN_V 410. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 300, JAPN_V 400 and one of JAPN_V 302, JAPN_V 402, JAPN_V 314, JAPN_V 424. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 451.description: A continuation of JAPN_V 450. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 451 or JAPN_V 411. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 410, JAPN_V 450. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 452.description: Advanced reading and analysis of scholarly texts in modern Japanese drawn from history, sociology, economics, etc. Advanced conversation, composition, and practice in the use of standard reference tools as preparation for independent research in Japanese. Students are recommended to complete JAPN_V 403 prior to taking JAPN_V 452. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 452 or JAPN_V 406. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 301, JAPN_V 401. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 453.description: An advanced course in the reading and analysis of literary texts in modern Japanese. Advanced conversation, translation into English and practice in the use of standard reference tools as preparation for advanced research in Japanese. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 453 or JAPN_V 408. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 301, JAPN_V 401. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 456.description: Developing fluency in reading contemporary Japanese newspapers; concentration on current and emerging vocabulary, evolving grammatical features, and style of presentation. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 456 or JAPN_V 416. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 301, JAPN_V 401 and one of JAPN_V 302, JAPN_V 402, JAPN_V 314, JAPN_V 424. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 457.description: A continuation of JAPN_V 456. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 457 or JAPN_V 417. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN_V 416, JAPN_V 456. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

JAPN 459.course_name: Topics in Japanese Language, Culture, and Society
JAPN 459.description: Advanced Japanese language course combined with analysis of various media in literary, journalistic, and popular genres drawn from history, sociology, cultural studies, etc. Practice in the use of standard reference tools prepares students for independent research in Japanese. Students are recommended to complete JAPN 403 prior to JAPN 459. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 459 or JAPN 419. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN 301, JAPN 401; and permission from instructor.

JAPN 460.description: Analysis of the grammatical structure of modern Japanese. Contrastive analysis of Japanese and English as well as error analysis. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 460 or JAPN 420. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN 301, JAPN 401 and one of JAPN 303, JAPN 403.

JAPN 461.description: A continuation of JAPN 460. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 461 or JAPN 421. Recommended pre-requisites: one of JAPN 420, JAPN 460.

JAPN 462.description: Research tools and approaches to the interdisciplinary study of modern Japanese religions (nineteenth century to the present) including state-of-the-field works in English, and locating primary and secondary materials in Japanese. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 462 or JAPN 452. Prerequisite: 6 credits of 200- or 300-level courses in Asian religions; 3 credit writing-intensive course in Asian Studies; ability to read modern Japanese or 18 credits of Japanese language courses and permission of instructor.

JAPN 465.description: Emphasizing the development of translingual and transcultural literacies in Japanese popular media with a primary focus on film. This course is recommended for students with credit for JAPN_V 401 and JAPN_V 402, or placement with native or near-native proficiency in Japanese.

JAPN 470.course_name: Supervised Study in the Japanese Language
JAPN 470.description: Primarily for graduate students. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN_V 470 or JAPN_V 440.

JAPN 472.course_name: Tutorial in Japanese for Honours Students
JAPN 472.description: This course will require the presentation of at least one research paper. Credit will be granted for only one of JAPN 472 or JAPN 442.
